scope: ReSpeaker source WAV replay on Pi5, observation only
limitations: Development recordings already used in experiments, not independent held-out accuracy.
Only included ReSpeaker recordings are counted. Other devices are excluded.
3 repeated runs do not multiply the number of independent recordings.
Recorded-WAV inference, not real-time microphone or hardware execution latency.
Benchmark and integrated observer are verified separately.
